fitAnalysis.assessment:
This is a weak fit (28% match) for the Senior Program Manager, Workplace Operations role at Airbnb.

**Strengths:**
- Automating journal checks in Excel VBA shows hands-on process automation
- Variance analysis and management reporting support data-driven decisions
- Advanced Excel and Power BI build analytical credibility

**Gaps:**
- Requires 12-15+ years in program management; you have about 6 in finance
- No program management tools experience (Airtable, JIRA) or workflow automation platforms
- No vendor management, change management, or global program delivery

**Recommendation:** Build program management experience and a PMP or similar credential first, and target finance-adjacent roles such as FP&A process improvement before applying to senior program roles.

coverLetter:
Tomas Brandt
Chicago, IL, USA
tomas.brandt@example.com
+1 555 0123

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Airbnb

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your Workplace Operations teams each run their own processes, tools and vendors across a global office footprint, and the manual effort and broken handoffs that follow are hard to see until someone maps them. I know that problem from finance. Our month-end close reporting took 9 working days, so I automated the journal checks in Excel VBA and brought it down to 6.

I'm a Financial Analyst with 5 years of experience in budgeting, forecasting and management reporting, and I won't pretend to have 12-15 years in program management. What I do have is the analytical side of your measurement frameworks and business cases. I own the monthly forecast and variance reporting for two business units with combined revenue of about 85 million USD, and I rebuilt the forecasting model for the larger unit around order backlog, lifting accuracy from 88% to 96%. I build Power BI dashboards on SAP data for plant managers, so I'm used to turning data into clear recommendations for audiences outside finance. I also found a recurring supplier rebate worth about 120,000 USD a year that nobody was claiming, which is the kind of gap-spotting your role asks for.

I'd welcome a conversation about how an analyst's habits of measuring, sizing opportunities and automating repetitive work could support your operational modernization. I'm available to talk at your convenience.

Best regards,
Tomas Brandt
